changes: Added a synthetic browser contract case covering both / and /?view=workspace defaults, Opportunities header navigation, a customer with separate Oil & Gas and Data Centers child projects, parent and child cohort tokens, paging across 26 customer groups, and sector URL state.

The synthetic parent route applies company sorting and region, stage, priority, and search matching over the full fixture before slicing pages. The browser assertions check selected customer results, request query context, URL state, and filter changes resetting offset.

Corrected the page-two fixture assertion after the focused browser run showed that priority sorting places the two ranked synthetic customers first; the final row is Customer 24. The page count and cohort-token assertions remain in place.

Added mocked same_name_unconfirmed coverage for exact name-group caption and identity count while collapsed and expanded, three distinct PECOS project/customer identity IDs, isolated contact links, each exact need detail, and Back to all three projects.

Refined the sort proof to reflect localeCompare's full order: Cross Sector Customer first, then Customer 01; ranked Filter Edge Customer is second under priority order and moves to the final page under company order.
Detail assertions now verify each latest exact-need read and deduplicated project visit order while allowing a repeated read after Back navigation.
Added a deep-link normalization case for legacy sort=project and a negative offset; asserts grouped requests use priority and offset 0 and the invalid URL parameters are removed.
Aligned only grouped result count and empty-state expectations with the frontend's neutral group wording; numerical, project, identity, and error assertions remain intact.

Moved grouped regression cases in project_results and dashboard onto the customer-rollup default. Retained one explicit groupBrowse=1 compatibility case. Existing accountBrowse=1 account paths were preserved.
Adapted flat-results-specific browser cases to use projectBrowse=1, including canonical table, cohort sorting, detail, shell, and legacy flat workspace flows.
